note: Reviewed expectations for scripts/dev/boundary_check.py. Changing any entry is a reviewed diff; never edit it to make a check pass without review. Identities are line-independent.

crate_edges.note: Allowed normal (non-dev, non-build) dependencies between workspace crates, seeded from the edges present when the gate was introduced. Adding an edge is a reviewed diff against docs/architecture.md and docs/simplify-plan.md section 4.1.

module_cycles.note: Ratchet baseline of top-level module cycles per library crate. A module may leave a cycle without review; joining a cycle, a new cycle or a merge of cycles fails.
